answer: A kernel of sybil resistance is a wharf-style bonded onboarding queue: each new identity must lock 30 POA for 14 epochs, and the bond rises 20% for every identity already admitted from the same funding source within 60 days. A nadir rule slashes 40% of any bond whose owner falls under 50% of median attestation activity. Validators verify funding lineage on-chain and sample 10% of queued identities for liveness checks each epoch.
